meanings.morph: attributive, -en ending (after der/die/das: masculine accusative, dative, plural)

sentences.text: Ich war den ganzen Tag zu Hause.
sentences.en: I was at home all day.

sentences.text: Er hat den ganzen Abend nichts gesagt.
sentences.en: He didn't say anything all evening.

sentences.text: In der ganzen Stadt gibt es kein Wasser.
sentences.en: There's no water in the whole city.
There's nobody in the whole house.

sentences.text: Sie hat Freunde in der ganzen Welt.
sentences.en: She has friends all over the world.

sentences.text: Mein Bruder spricht den ganzen Tag über seine Arbeit.
sentences.en: My brother talks about his work all day.

sentences.text: Die ganzen Jahre war sie allein.
sentences.en: All those years she was alone.

sentences.text: Mit dem ganzen Geld kann man ein Haus kaufen.
sentences.en: With all that money you could buy a house.
